title: Your first snapshot
brief: A new file just appeared in your project, but Git is not tracking it yet. Move it into the index, then take your first snapshot.

goals.label: A commit with the message "hello world" exists

hints: git status shows hello.txt as untracked. A commit can only see files that are in the index.
git add hello.txt moves the file into the index.
Then take the snapshot: git commit -m "hello world"
